layoutNotes: Concept map: circular contained plaza with central data extractor, conveyor side lanes, symmetrical spawn rooms, catwalks, lifts, and two-to-three-level vertical combat.
Main lane drives from south entry through central extractor to north extraction; flank routes run east/west through conveyor channels; upper catwalk ring overlooks the plaza.
userData.artStyle: Halo Combat Evolved / Half-Life 2 era low-poly industrial sci-fi blockout
userData.identityWarning: Bots use monochrome green, industrial metal, SPYD3R network screens, data extractors, conveyors, server racks, drones, and corrupted automation motifs.
userData.containmentRule: fully sealed contained FPS arena; void/drop areas are fenced or marked; only authored gates connect rooms
userData.coordinateNote: position.y is object center; scale.y is height. Upper walkways use elevated center-Y. Ground route overlays are path/debug indicators.
